headline: The billion-lira fortune of Emre Tezmen has come to light
summary: Real estate linked to Emre Tezmen, arrested in a fund investigation, has surfaced. It includes a car park and bazaar in Nişantaşı worth about 2 billion lira and hotel projects in Germany.
why: Investigations into investment funds can lead to asset freezes and regulatory scrutiny, which matter to investors in Turkish funds and real estate. Turkey's Istanbul district of Nişantaşı is a major commercial property area.
